{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate by site
table = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100

table"}
